reviews.review: very enjoyable. has a Destiny 2 / Warframe feel but is it's own game. It doesn't seem as flexible as Warframe in that you cannot purchase items from other players that I've seen and the Battle Pass is funded by a special currency instead of it just being bought with regular cash. Would still recommend it to those that enjoy this type of game. The enemy models are also much more on the mech side than the cancerous monster side.

The First Descendant delivers fast-paced, action-packed gameplay with a satisfying arsenal of futuristic weapons. Combat feels smooth and impactful, especially in co-op, where the game truly shines thanks to a solid player base and team-focused missions.

The female characters are stylishly designed, with bold outfits and animations that add a bit of fan service without taking away from the core experience. While the game emphasizes movement and combat, the visual presentation definitely stands out.

The story isn’t a major focus, but since it’s a live-service title, there’s always new content rolling out. It can be demanding on your system and a bit repetitive over time, but overall, it’s a fun and flashy shooter worth jumping into—especially with friends.
I have never played a game like this before and this is the first one I have played and I love it!
